spots.name: Tigardville Station
spots.description: Formerly known as Manila Express and located in the oldest building in Old Town Tigard, Tigardville Station has a long and colorful history. One thing that remains constant, is their devotion to their clients. The Tigardville Station Menu features selections not typically found in similar establishments as well as some of your favorites all prepared exceptionally well. You will find some of the Portland area's finest Mixologists on staff and the third prong in the triad of excellence is the terrific service. Glasses do not stay empty long at Tigardville Station.
